name: Zhejiang Zhongjian Technology Co.,Ltd
summary: Zhejiang Zhongjian Technology Co.,Ltd engages in the research and development, production, and sale of various garden machinery products in China and internationally. It offers chainsaws, hair dryer, brush cutters, hedge trimmers, push lawn mowers, riding lawn mowers, and generator products. The company also engages in development, research, and manufacturing of advanced intelligent robots. Zhejiang Zhongjian Technology Co.,Ltd was formerly known as Yongkang Zhongjian Tools Manufacture Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Zhejiang Zhongjian Technology Co.,Ltd in December 2010. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Yongkang, China.
